programs.description: Bringing the best in television.
The host engages in a meaningful conversation with the viewers and plays Tamil movie songs on their requests.
A comprehensive compilation of popular melodious songs composed and performed by various renowned artists played back to back.
A comprehensive compilation of popular devotional songs in praise of deities performed by eminent artists is played back-to-back.
A religious scholar sheds light on the history behind various temples, as well as the significance and meaning of diverse rituals and customs.
A religious leader sheds light on various teachings and principles from the Hindu scriptures and encourages followers to reflect on the same.
A renowned astrologer provides a comprehensive insight into the position of stars and makes astrological predictions for the 12 zodiac signs.
The host provides the latest information, advancements, and developments regarding various political, economic and social issues.
The hosts interact with renowned personalities and also present the latest updates from across the globe, ranging from entertainment to technology.
When Hanuman, an ordinary boy, is blessed with extraordinary powers, he sets out on an adventurous journey and conquers various obstacles.
Janani and the women of the household embark on a journey to pursue their ambitions in the wake of Aadhimuthu Gunasekaran's downfall, while navigating the challenges of society.
Kayal, a selfless woman, earns to provide for her family after her father abandons them. Despite being overwhelmed with responsibilities, she puts her loved ones' well-being before her own happiness.
The host welcomes celebrity guests as they whip up their signature dishes alongside high-end chef creations, rustic village recipes and much more.
Poongodi's quest for self-establishment leads her to Saravanan, a man unwittingly controlled by his stepmother's manipulative ways.
A kind-hearted Tulasi strives hard to keep her family together and secure the happiness, well-being and future of her children at all costs.
When circumstances compel an ambitious woman to wed a man with a tough personality, their initial friction slowly gives way to mutual understanding and eventually love.
Abirami, a loving mother and devoted wife, places her family's happiness above all else. After enduring endless disrespect, she, with her daughter's support, sets out to rebuild her life.
While weathering deep family turmoil, fate brings Dharmadurai and Parvathi together as they navigate greed and betrayal.
Bringing the best in television.
Maha, her family's primary breadwinner, wants to keep supporting her family even after marrying Selvam. However, things become complicated as obstacles test their family bonds and marriage.
Bringing the best in cinema.
The host provides the latest information, advancements, and developments regarding various political, economic and social issues.
Annam, a bright and cheerful young woman, faces the challenges of life while withstanding the harsh treatment from her stepmother.
After losing her family in a tragedy, Bhairavi's life crumbles as she starts over at an unwelcoming home and job. But her goal to investigate the truth behind the accident pushes her forward.
Prabhu is a miser and puts his needs ahead of his family. Circumstances bring him closer to Aadhirai, who helps others selflessly.
Nandini, a vivacious girl, gets married to Suryakumar, a businessman. However, the couple strives to navigate their relationship along with balancing familial responsibilities.
Anandi, a village belle, embarks on a solo journey to fulfil her duties as a daughter and shoulder the responsibilities of her family.

A bodacious village girl's life transforms when she bonds with a loving father and his daughter, uncovering the true meaning of love, family and belonging.
Bringing the best in television.
While the parents search for a suitable prospect for their daughter Selvi's marriage, she expresses her desire to get married to a joint family.
